planted.item: The board authorises management to negotiate the renewal, provided the liability cap is not reduced below four hundred thousand dollars.
The board resolved to appoint Maria Ek as Chief Financial Officer.
The board resolved not to propose an interim dividend and will revisit the matter at the September meeting.
Petra Voss will send the board's position to Harrowgate by Friday.
Sofia Berg will prepare Maria Ek's service agreement for signature by the end of May.
Petra Voss will draft a short note to shareholders explaining the decision before the end of June.
Whether the board accepts the fee increase is still open.

sources.quote: Four of the six directors are present, so the meeting is quorate.
sources.speaker: Karin Lindqvist

sources.quote: I declare an interest in the Northbridge project because a family member works there.
sources.speaker: Anders Holm

sources.quote: You will not take part in item four.

sources.quote: The fee rises to nineteen thousand seven hundred and fifty dollars a month.
sources.speaker: Petra Voss

sources.quote: They also offer a liability cap of five hundred thousand dollars, up from two hundred and fifty thousand.
sources.speaker: Petra Voss

items.text: Petra Voss reports that Harrowgate offers a liability cap of five hundred thousand dollars, up from two hundred and fifty thousand.

sources.quote: I am comfortable with the cap but the fee increase is steep for a two year term.
sources.speaker: Sofia Berg

items.text: Sofia Berg expresses concern about the steep fee increase for a two year term.

sources.quote: Could we ask for a three year term at the current fee instead?
sources.speaker: Erik Nyström

items.text: Erik Nyström asks if the term can be extended to three years at the current fee.

sources.quote: We can ask, but they have not indicated any flexibility on the fee so far.
sources.speaker: Petra Voss

items.text: Petra Voss states that they can ask but Harrowgate has not indicated any flexibility on the fee so far.
